note: A retirement is a preservation claim, not a story about a red run. Every entry registers the retired path (file), the original path it was retired from (original_path), the sha256 of the preserved bytes (the retirement's retired_sha256), the commit those bytes are claimed to come from (retired_from_commit), a free-text reason, the registration date (retired_on) and the review that accepted the retirement (review_reference). scripts/verify-retirement-registry.js reads no test output. It checks five things from files, hashes and the object store: (a) preserved - the file at the registered path hashes to the registered sha256; (b) complete - every file under tests/legacy/ is registered; (c) not a fake retirement - the original path does not still carry the registered bytes; (d) re-evaluable - the registered bytes are put back at the original path and run, and a passing run is named as a receipt (KDNA-RETIREMENT-RESTORABLE) because the entry is not stale; (e) zero rewrite - the registered sha256 is the sha256 of the bytes at original_path in retired_from_commit, read from the object store, so a move that rewrote the file on the way into tests/legacy/ cannot be registered as a retirement. Only (a)-(c) and (e) decide the exit code. One entry survives under this criterion: the pd275 terminal suite, whose move rewrote nothing because its only relative specifier, './session-harness', is one directory down from both paths. Every other file registered here had been rewritten by its move and is a current test again, byte for byte.

entries.reason: The suite drives the pre-component-semantics session protocol: it expects session events and material kinds the current session surface does not emit, and it fails when its registered bytes are put back at the original path. It is the one entry whose move rewrote nothing - './session-harness' is the same one directory down from tests/pd275/ and from tests/legacy/pd275/ - so its registered sha256 is the sha256 the original path carried in 1f5049b. The harness module it requires was rewritten by the same move and is therefore not retired material under criterion (e): it is back at tests/pd275/session-harness.js.
